source.text: תְּפִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥דשִׁמְעָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה׀צֶ֗דֶק הַקְשִׁ֥יבָה רִנָּתִ֗י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה תְפִלָּתִ֑י בְּ֝לֹ֗א שִׂפְתֵ֥י מִרְמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: A prayer of David. Hear, YHWH, righteousness; attend to my cry; give ear to my prayer, not with lips of deceit.

en.L: A prayer of David. Hear, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, [what is] right; attend to my cry; give ear to my prayer, [which is] not from lips of deceit.
en.B: A prayer of David. Hear a just cause, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}; listen closely to my cry. Turn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ear to my prayer, which comes from lips that do not lie.
en.R: A prayer of David. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, hear me, because I am in the right. Listen when I call out to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. Pay attention to my prayer. I am not lying to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Une prière de David. Écoute, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, [ce qui est] juste ; sois attentif à mon cri ; prête l’oreille à ma prière, [qui ne vient] pas de lèvres trompeuses.
fr.B: Une prière de David. Écoute une juste cause, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; sois attentif à mon cri. Tends {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} oreille vers ma prière, qui sort de lèvres sans mensonge.
fr.R: Une prière de David. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, écoute-moi, car je suis dans mon droit. Écoute quand je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appelle. Fais attention à ma prière. Je ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} mens pas.

sw.L: Maombi ya Daudi. Sikia, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, [lililo] haki; usikilize kilio changu; utege sikio kwa maombi yangu, [yasiyotoka] katika midomo ya hila.
sw.B: Maombi ya Daudi. Sikia kesi ya haki, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; sikiliza kwa makini kilio changu. Utege sikio {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} kwa maombi yangu, yanayotoka katika midomo isiyosema uongo.
sw.R: Maombi ya Daudi. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unisikie, kwa sababu niko sahihi. Unisikilize ninapokulilia. Uyasikilize maombi yangu. Sikudanganyi.

es.L: Oración de David. Oye, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, [lo que es] justo; atiende a mi clamor; presta oído a mi oración, [que no sale] de labios engañosos.
es.B: Oración de David. Escucha una causa justa, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; atiende con cuidado a mi clamor. Inclina {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} oído a mi oración, que sale de labios que no mienten.
es.R: Oración de David. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, escúchame, porque tengo la razón. Escucha cuando clamo a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Presta atención a mi oración. No {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} estoy mintiendo.

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: This psalm's title is short and the Hebrew counts it together with the first line as verse 1, so here the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: righteousness: a just cause
decisions.reason: The word (tsedeq) is the object of "hear": the psalmist asks God to hear a case that is in the right, as a judge hears a plea (verse 2).

decisions.choice: not with lips of deceit: an honest prayer
decisions.reason: He prays with no lie on his lips, unlike the flatterers of 12:3.

decisions.choice: A prayer: a title used for a few psalms
decisions.reason: The title "prayer" (tefillah) heads this psalm and Psalms 86, 90, 102 and 142.

source.text: מִ֭לְּפָנֶיךָ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣י יֵצֵ֑א עֵ֝ינֶ֗יךָ תֶּחֱזֶ֥ינָה מֵישָׁרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: From before your face my judgment will come forth; your eyes will see uprightness.

en.L: From before {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face let my judgment come forth; let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} eyes see what is upright.
en.B: Let my verdict come from {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} eyes see what is fair.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, please decide my case. You can see what is right.

fr.L: Que de devant {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face sorte mon jugement ; que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} yeux voient ce qui est droit.
fr.B: Que mon verdict vienne de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} yeux voient ce qui est équitable.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, s’il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît, juge ma cause. Tu vois ce qui est juste.

sw.L: Kutoka mbele ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} hukumu yangu itoke; macho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yaone yaliyo sawa.
sw.B: Hukumu yangu itoke {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}; macho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yaone yaliyo ya haki.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, tafadhali uamue kesi yangu. Wewe unaona yaliyo sahihi.

es.L: Que de delante de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro salga mi juicio; que {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} ojos vean lo recto.
es.B: Que mi sentencia venga de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; que {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} ojos vean lo que es justo.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, por favor, decide mi caso. Tú puedes ver lo que es correcto.

decisions.choice: my judgment: the decision in my case
decisions.reason: The word (mishpat) is a ruling in court; the psalmist asks God to decide his case.

decisions.choice: let it come forth: a wish
decisions.reason: The verbs can be read as wishes or as statements; as a prayer they ask God to give his verdict.

decisions.choice: uprightness: what is fair and straight
decisions.reason: The plural (mesharim) means what is right and even, a fair judgment (9:9).

decisions.choice: LORD
decisions.reason: Readable names the one addressed so that the short sentences are clear.

source.text: בָּ֘חַ֤נְתָּ לִבִּ֨י׀פָּ֘קַ֤דְתָּ לַּ֗יְלָה צְרַפְתַּ֥נִי בַל־תִּמְצָ֑א זַ֝מֹּתִ֗י בַּל־יַעֲבָר־פִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: You have tested my heart; you have visited [by] night; you have refined me; you will find nothing; I have purposed: my mouth will not transgress.

en.L: You have tested my heart; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have visited [me by] night; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have refined me [and] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will find nothing; I have resolved [that] my mouth will not transgress.
en.B: You have tested my heart and come to me in the night; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have put me through the fire and found nothing wrong. I have made up my mind not to sin with my mouth.
en.R: You have looked deep inside me. You have come to me at night and tested me, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} found nothing wrong. I have decided that I will not say anything bad.

fr.L: Tu as éprouvé mon cœur ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [m’]as visité [de] nuit ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as passé au creuset [et] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne trouveras rien ; j’ai résolu [que] ma bouche ne transgressera pas.
fr.B: Tu as éprouvé mon cœur et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es venu à moi dans la nuit ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as passé au feu et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’as rien trouvé de mal. J’ai pris la décision de ne pas pécher par ma bouche.
fr.R: Tu as regardé tout au fond de moi. Tu es venu la nuit pour m’éprouver, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’as rien trouvé de mal. J’ai décidé de ne rien dire de mauvais.

sw.L: Umeujaribu moyo wangu; umenijia usiku; umenisafisha [na] hutaona kitu; nimeazimu [kwamba] kinywa changu hakitakosa.
sw.B: Umeujaribu moyo wangu na kunijia usiku; umenipitisha motoni ukaona hakuna kosa. Nimeamua kutotenda dhambi kwa kinywa changu.
sw.R: Umenichunguza ndani kabisa. Umenijia usiku na kunijaribu, {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} hukuona kosa lolote. Nimeamua kwamba sitasema neno baya.

es.L: Tú has probado mi corazón; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me has visitado [de] noche; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me has refinado [y] no hallarás nada; he resuelto [que] mi boca no transgreda.
es.B: Tú has probado mi corazón y has venido a mí de noche; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me has pasado por el fuego y no has encontrado nada malo. He decidido no pecar con mi boca.
es.R: Tú has mirado dentro de mí. Has venido a mí de noche y me has probado, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no encontraste nada malo. He decidido que no diré nada malo.

decisions.choice: refined me: tested me as metal in a furnace
decisions.reason: The verb (tsaraf) is used for refining silver (12:7); God has tested the psalmist as metal is tested.

decisions.choice: visited by night: came to examine me
decisions.reason: To visit (paqad) can mean to inspect; God searches the psalmist at night, when thoughts are hidden (16:7).

decisions.choice: I have purposed: my mouth will not transgress
alternatives: my thoughts do not go beyond my mouth
decisions.reason: The words are hard to divide. They may mean that he has resolved not to sin in speech, or that what he thinks does not go beyond what he says. Either way his words and his heart agree.

decisions.choice: you will find nothing: a claim of innocence in this case
decisions.reason: The psalmist does not claim to be sinless; he claims to be innocent of what his enemies charge him with (7:4-6).

source.text: לִפְעֻלּ֣וֹת אָ֭דָם בִּדְבַ֣ר שְׂפָתֶ֑יךָ אֲנִ֥י שָׁ֝מַ֗רְתִּי אָרְח֥וֹת פָּרִֽיץ׃

records.literal_gloss: As for [the] deeds of man, by [the] word of your lips I have kept [from the] paths of [the] violent.

en.L: As for the deeds of humankind, by the word of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} lips I have kept [myself from] the paths of the violent.
en.B: Whatever others may do, I have kept to the word that comes from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} lips and stayed off the roads of the violent.
en.R: Other people do wrong things. But I have listened to what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} say, and I have stayed away from violent people.

fr.L: Quant aux actions des humains, par la parole de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} lèvres je [me] suis gardé des sentiers du violent.
fr.B: Quoi que fassent les autres, je m’en suis tenu à la parole sortie de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} lèvres et je suis resté loin des routes des violents.
fr.R: Les autres font des choses mauvaises. Mais moi, j’ai écouté ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} dis, et je suis resté loin des gens violents.

sw.L: Kwa habari ya matendo ya wanadamu, kwa neno la midomo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} nimejilinda [na] njia za wenye jeuri.
sw.B: Wengine watende watakavyo, mimi nimeshika neno linalotoka midomoni {{deity_pronoun:mwako|Mwako}} na kujiepusha na njia za wenye jeuri.
sw.R: Watu wengine hutenda mabaya. Lakini mimi nimesikiliza unayosema, nami nimejitenga na watu wenye jeuri.

es.L: En cuanto a las obras de los humanos, por la palabra de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} labios me he guardado de las sendas del violento.
es.B: Hagan lo que hagan los demás, yo me he mantenido en la palabra que sale de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} labios y me he apartado de los caminos de los violentos.
es.R: Otras personas hacen cosas malas. Pero yo he escuchado lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} dices, y me he alejado de la gente violenta.

decisions.choice: I have kept from the paths of the violent
alternatives: I have watched the paths of the violent
I have kept the word of your lips
decisions.reason: The verse is hard to construe. Most likely, guided by God's word, the psalmist has kept away from the ways of violent people. The verb can also mean that he has kept God's word, or watched out for the violent.

decisions.choice: the violent: robbers, men who break in
decisions.reason: The word (parits) means one who breaks through, a robber (Jeremiah 7:11).

decisions.choice: kept from / stayed off / stayed away from
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has no "from"; the meaning followed (m1) needs it.

records.literal_gloss: Holding fast my steps in your tracks; not have slipped my feet.

en.L: My steps have held fast in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} tracks; my feet have not slipped.
en.B: My steps have held to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} tracks; my feet have never slid.
en.R: I have walked in the way {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} showed me. I have not stumbled.

fr.L: Mes pas se sont tenus fermes dans {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} traces ; mes pieds n’ont pas glissé.
fr.B: Mes pas ont suivi {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} traces ; mes pieds n’ont jamais dérapé.
fr.R: J’ai marché sur le chemin que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as montré. Je n’ai pas trébuché.

sw.L: Hatua zangu zimeshikamana na nyayo {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}; miguu yangu haikuteleza.
sw.B: Hatua zangu zimefuata nyayo {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}; miguu yangu haijateleza kamwe.

es.L: Mis pasos se han mantenido firmes en {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} huellas; mis pies no han resbalado.
es.B: Mis pasos han seguido {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} huellas; mis pies nunca han resbalado.
es.R: He caminado por el camino que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me mostraste. No he tropezado.

decisions.choice: your tracks: the paths God marks out
decisions.reason: The word (ma'gal) is a track or rut, the way a wagon goes; God's tracks are his ways (23:3).

decisions.choice: holding fast: a statement or a prayer
alternatives: Hold my steps fast in your paths
decisions.reason: The verb form can be read as a statement ("my steps have held fast") or as a request ("hold my steps fast"). It is read here as a statement, matching verse 4.

decisions.choice: slipped: wavered
decisions.reason: The verb is the one of 13:5 and 16:8.

source.text: אֲנִֽי־קְרָאתִ֣יךָ כִֽי־תַעֲנֵ֣נִי אֵ֑ל הַֽט־אָזְנְךָ֥ לִ֝֗י שְׁמַ֣ע אִמְרָתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: I, I call on you, for you will answer me, God; incline your ear to me, hear my word.

en.L: I call on {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will answer me, God; incline {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ear to me, hear my word.
en.B: I call to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} answer me, God; bend {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ear toward me and listen to what I say.
en.R: God, I call to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} because I know {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will answer me. Listen to me. Hear what I am saying.

fr.L: Moi, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appelle, car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me répondras, Dieu ; tends vers moi {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} oreille, écoute ma parole.
fr.B: Je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appelle, car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me réponds, Dieu ; penche {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} oreille vers moi et écoute ce que je dis.
fr.R: Dieu, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appelle parce que je sais que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me répondras. Écoute-moi. Entends ce que je dis.

sw.L: Mimi ninakuita, kwa maana utanijibu, Ee Mungu; unitegee sikio {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, uisikie kauli yangu.
sw.B: Ninakuita, kwa maana unanijibu, Ee Mungu; uinamishe sikio {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} kwangu na usikilize ninayosema.
sw.R: Mungu, ninakuita kwa sababu ninajua utanijibu. Unisikilize. Usikie ninayosema.

es.L: Yo {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} invoco, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me responderás, oh Dios; inclina {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} oído hacia mí, escucha mi palabra.
es.B: Clamo a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me respondes, oh Dios; inclina {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} oído hacia mí y escucha lo que digo.
es.R: Dios, clamo a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} porque sé que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me responderás. Escúchame. Oye lo que digo.

decisions.choice: I: the psalmist sets himself before God
decisions.reason: The pronoun is written out for emphasis: it is I who call, confident of an answer.

decisions.choice: incline your ear: listen closely
decisions.reason: To incline the ear is to bend down to listen (31:3; 2 Kings 19:16).

decisions.choice: I know
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that "for you will answer" is the psalmist's confidence.

source.text: הַפְלֵ֣ה חֲ֭סָדֶיךָ מוֹשִׁ֣יעַ חוֹסִ֑ים מִ֝מִּתְקוֹמְמִ֗ים בִּֽימִינֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Make wonderful your loyal loves, savior of [those who] take refuge from [those who] rise up, by your right hand.

en.L: Make wonderful {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love, Savior of those who take refuge from those who rise up [against them] by {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand.
en.B: Show {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love in a wonderful way, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} who by {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand save those who come to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for shelter from their attackers.
en.R: Show me {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love in an amazing way! People run to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for safety from their enemies, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} use {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} great power to save them.

fr.L: Rends merveilleux {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal, Sauveur de ceux qui se réfugient loin de ceux qui se dressent [contre eux], par {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} droite.
fr.B: Montre de façon merveilleuse {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui, par {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main droite, sauves ceux qui viennent chercher abri auprès de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} contre leurs agresseurs.
fr.R: Montre-moi {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle d’une façon extraordinaire ! Des gens courent vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} pour se protéger de leurs ennemis, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} sers de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} grande puissance pour les sauver.

sw.L: Ufanye upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma uwe wa ajabu, Ee Mwokozi wa wanaotafuta kimbilio kutoka kwa wale wanaowainukia, kwa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume.
sw.B: Uonyeshe upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma kwa njia ya ajabu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unayewaokoa kwa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume wale wanaokimbilia {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} ili kujikinga na washambuliaji wao.
sw.R: Unionyeshe upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma kwa njia ya ajabu! Watu hukukimbilia {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ili wawe salama mbali na adui zao, {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} unatumia nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} kuu kuwaokoa.

es.L: Haz maravilloso {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal, Salvador de los que se refugian de los que se levantan [contra ellos] por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} diestra.
es.B: Muestra {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel de manera maravillosa, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} que con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano derecha salvas a los que acuden a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} buscando refugio de sus atacantes.
es.R: ¡Muéstrame {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel de una manera asombrosa! La gente corre hacia {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} para estar a salvo de sus enemigos, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} usas {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gran poder para salvarlos.

decisions.choice: your loyal loves: your acts of loyal love
decisions.reason: The plural of chesed means acts of loyal love; the word is explained at 13:6.

decisions.choice: by your right hand: how God saves
alternatives: those who take refuge in your right hand
decisions.reason: "By your right hand" most likely goes with "savior": God saves by his power. It may instead tell where they take refuge.

decisions.choice: your right hand: your power
decisions.reason: The right hand stands for strength in action (Exodus 15:6).

decisions.choice: loyal love (B); faithful love (R)
decisions.reason: As in 13:6.

decisions.choice: great power
decisions.reason: Readable says what the right hand stands for (m3).

source.text: שָׁ֭מְרֵנִי כְּאִישׁ֣וֹן בַּת־עָ֑יִן בְּצֵ֥ל כְּ֝נָפֶ֗יךָ תַּסְתִּירֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Keep me as [the] pupil, [the] daughter of [the] eye; in [the] shadow of your wings you will hide me

en.L: Keep me as the pupil, the daughter of the eye; in the shadow of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wings hide me,
en.B: Guard me as one guards the pupil of the eye; shelter me under the shade of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wings,
en.R: Protect me the way people protect their own eyes. Hide me under {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wings, like a bird hides its young.

fr.L: Garde-moi comme la pupille, la fille de l’œil ; à l’ombre de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ailes cache-moi,
fr.B: Garde-moi comme on garde la prunelle de l’œil ; abrite-moi à l’ombre de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ailes,
fr.R: Protège-moi comme les gens protègent leurs propres yeux. Cache-moi sous {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ailes, comme un oiseau cache ses petits.

sw.L: Unilinde kama mboni, binti wa jicho; katika kivuli cha mbawa {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} unifiche,
sw.B: Unilinde kama mtu anavyoilinda mboni ya jicho lake; unihifadhi chini ya kivuli cha mbawa {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}},
sw.R: Unilinde kama watu wanavyoyalinda macho yao wenyewe. Unifiche chini ya mbawa {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, kama ndege anavyowaficha makinda yake.

es.L: Guárdame como a la pupila, la niña del ojo; en la sombra de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} alas escóndeme,
es.B: Cuídame como se cuida la pupila del ojo; protégeme bajo la sombra de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} alas,
es.R: Protégeme como la gente protege sus propios ojos. Escóndeme bajo {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} alas, como un ave esconde a sus polluelos.

decisions.choice: the pupil, the daughter of the eye: what is guarded most carefully
decisions.reason: The pupil is called the "little man" ('ishon) and the "daughter" of the eye, perhaps from the small image of oneself seen in another's eye. It is what a person protects without thinking (Deuteronomy 32:10).

decisions.choice: the shadow of your wings: God's protection
decisions.reason: The picture is of a bird covering its young (Deuteronomy 32:11; 36:8; 57:2).

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: The prayer continues into verse 9 ("from the wicked ..."), so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: like a bird hides its young
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture (m2).

source.text: מִפְּנֵ֣י רְ֭שָׁעִים ז֣וּ שַׁדּ֑וּנִי אֹיְבַ֥י בְּ֝נֶ֗פֶשׁ יַקִּ֥יפוּ עָלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: from [the] presence of [the] wicked who have assailed me, my enemies against [my] soul, [who] surround me.

en.L: from the presence of the wicked who have assailed me, my enemies [who] against [my] soul surround me.
en.B: from the wicked who attack me, from deadly enemies who close in around me.
en.R: Keep me safe from wicked people who attack me. My enemies are all around me, and they want to kill me.

fr.L: de la présence des méchants qui m’ont dévasté, de mes ennemis [qui] contre [mon] âme m’entourent.
fr.B: loin des méchants qui m’attaquent, loin des ennemis mortels qui se resserrent autour de moi.
fr.R: Garde-moi en sécurité loin des méchants qui m’attaquent. Mes ennemis sont tout autour de moi, et ils veulent me tuer.

sw.L: kutoka mbele ya waovu walionishambulia, adui zangu wanaonizunguka ili kuitoa nafsi [yangu].
sw.B: kutoka kwa waovu wanaonishambulia, kutoka kwa adui wanaotaka kuniua wanaonizingira.
sw.R: Unilinde salama mbali na watu waovu wanaonishambulia. Adui zangu wamenizunguka pande zote, nao wanataka kuniua.

es.L: de la presencia de los malvados que me han asaltado, mis enemigos [que] contra [mi] alma me rodean.
es.B: de los malvados que me atacan, de los enemigos mortales que me cercan.
es.R: Mantenme a salvo de los malvados que me atacan. Mis enemigos están a mi alrededor y quieren matarme.

decisions.choice: against my soul: out to take my life
decisions.reason: "Against the soul" most likely means that they seek his life. The word nefesh can also mean appetite or greed.

decisions.choice: assailed me: ruined, plundered
decisions.reason: The verb (shadad) means to destroy or plunder; they are out to ruin him.

records.literal_gloss: Their fat they have closed up; [with] their mouth they have spoken with pride.

en.L: Their fat they have closed up; [with] their mouth they have spoken in pride.
en.B: They have shut up their hearts, hardened with fat; their mouths speak proud words.
en.R: They do not care about anyone. They talk proudly about themselves.

fr.L: Leur graisse, ils l’ont fermée ; [de] leur bouche ils ont parlé avec orgueil.
fr.B: Ils ont fermé leur cœur, épaissi de graisse ; leur bouche dit des paroles orgueilleuses.
fr.R: Ils ne se soucient de personne. Ils parlent d’eux-mêmes avec orgueil.

sw.L: Mafuta yao wameyafunga; [kwa] kinywa chao wamesema kwa kiburi.
sw.B: Wameifunga mioyo yao iliyonenepa kwa mafuta; vinywa vyao vinasema maneno ya kiburi.
sw.R: Hawamjali mtu yeyote. Wanajisifu kwa kiburi.

es.L: Su grasa han cerrado; [con] su boca han hablado con soberbia.
es.B: Han cerrado su corazón, endurecido por la grasa; sus bocas dicen palabras soberbias.
es.R: No les importa nadie. Hablan con orgullo de sí mismos.

decisions.choice: closed up their fat: hardened their hearts
alternatives: closed their hearts (with a small change)
decisions.reason: Fat around the heart is a picture of a heart that feels nothing (73:7; 119:70). With a small change the words would read "they have closed their heart"; the meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: pride: arrogance
decisions.reason: The word (ge'ut) is haughtiness, a proud spirit that looks down on others.

decisions.choice: hearts
decisions.reason: Balanced says what the fat is a picture of (m1) and keeps the picture.

source.text: אַ֭שֻּׁרֵינוּ עַתָּ֣ה סְבָב֑וּנוּ עֵינֵיהֶ֥ם יָ֝שִׁ֗יתוּ לִנְט֥וֹת בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: [At] our steps now they have surrounded us; their eyes they set to bend down to the ground,

en.L: [At] our steps now they have surrounded us; they set their eyes to bring [us] down to the ground,
en.B: Now they track our steps and surround us; their eyes are fixed on throwing us to the ground,
en.R: They follow us wherever we go and have us surrounded. They watch closely, waiting to knock us down.

fr.L: [À] nos pas, maintenant, ils nous ont entourés ; ils fixent leurs yeux pour [nous] abattre à terre,
fr.B: Maintenant ils suivent nos pas et nous encerclent ; leurs yeux ne cherchent qu’à nous jeter à terre,
fr.R: Ils nous suivent partout où nous allons et nous ont encerclés. Ils nous surveillent de près, en attendant de nous renverser.

sw.L: [Katika] hatua zetu sasa wametuzunguka; wanakaza macho yao ili [kutuangusha] chini ardhini,
sw.B: Sasa wanafuatilia hatua zetu na kutuzingira; macho yao yamekazwa kututupa chini,
sw.R: Wanatufuata kila tunapokwenda na wametuzingira. Wanatuangalia kwa makini, wakingoja kutuangusha.

es.L: [En] nuestros pasos ahora nos han rodeado; fijan sus ojos para derribarnos en tierra,
es.B: Ahora siguen nuestros pasos y nos rodean; tienen los ojos fijos en tirarnos al suelo,
es.R: Nos siguen a dondequiera que vamos y nos tienen rodeados. Nos vigilan de cerca, esperando para derribarnos.

decisions.choice: surrounded us: the word as read, not as written
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text writes "they have surrounded me" and its notes say to read "us". The words follow the form to be read; the psalmist speaks for himself and those with him.

decisions.choice: set their eyes to bend down to the ground: intent on bringing them down
alternatives: their eyes to the ground, like a lion stalking
decisions.reason: They watch for the moment to throw the psalmist to the earth, like the lion of verse 12. Some read it of eyes lowered as a hunter crouches.

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: The picture continues into verse 12, so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

source.text: דִּמְיֹנ֗וֹ כְּ֭אַרְיֵה יִכְס֣וֹף לִטְר֑וֹף וְ֝כִכְפִ֗יר יֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּמִסְתָּרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: His likeness [is] like a lion [that] longs to tear, and like a young lion sitting in hidden places.

en.L: his likeness [is] like a lion [that] longs to tear, and like a young lion sitting in hiding places.
en.B: like a lion eager to tear its prey, like a young lion crouching in its lair.
en.R: They are like a lion ready to tear its prey apart. They are like a young lion hiding and waiting to attack.

fr.L: son allure [est] comme [celle d’]un lion [qui] brûle de déchirer, et comme un jeune lion tapi dans les cachettes.
fr.B: pareils à un lion avide de déchirer sa proie, à un jeune lion tapi dans son repaire.
fr.R: Ils sont comme un lion prêt à mettre sa proie en pièces. Ils sont comme un jeune lion caché qui attend pour attaquer.

sw.L: mfano wake [ni] kama simba anayetamani kurarua, na kama mwana-simba aketiye mafichoni.
sw.B: kama simba mwenye hamu ya kurarua mawindo yake, kama mwana-simba anayevizia pangoni mwake.
sw.R: Wao ni kama simba aliye tayari kurarua mawindo yake. Wao ni kama mwana-simba anayejificha akingoja kushambulia.

es.L: su semejanza [es] como un león [que] ansía despedazar, y como un leoncillo sentado en escondrijos.
es.B: como un león ansioso de despedazar su presa, como un leoncillo agazapado en su guarida.
es.R: Son como un león listo para despedazar a su presa. Son como un león joven escondido, esperando para atacar.

decisions.choice: his likeness: the enemy as one figure
decisions.reason: The enemies of verse 11 are now pictured as one lion; "his" is the enemy as a type, as in 10:9.

decisions.choice: a lion, a young lion: hunters of the land
decisions.reason: Lions lived in the thickets of Israel (Jeremiah 49:19); the young lion is one in its full strength.

decisions.choice: like a lion (B); They are like a lion (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew describes one figure ("he", "his") who stands for everyone who acts this way. Balanced and Readable make the portrait plural, as Psalm 10 does with "the wicked", which includes men and women alike; Literal keeps the Hebrew singular.

source.text: קוּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה קַדְּמָ֣ה פָ֭נָיו הַכְרִיעֵ֑הוּ פַּלְּטָ֥ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י מֵרָשָׁ֥ע חַרְבֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Arise, YHWH, confront his face; make him bow down; deliver my soul from [the] wicked [by] your sword,

en.L: Arise, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, confront his face; make him bow down; deliver my soul from the wicked [by] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} sword,
en.B: Rise up, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}! Meet them face to face and bring them to their knees. Rescue me from the wicked with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} sword,
en.R: Get up, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}! Stand against them and knock them down! Use {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} sword to save me from wicked people.

fr.L: Lève-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, affronte sa face ; fais-le plier ; délivre mon âme du méchant [par] {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} épée,
fr.B: Debout, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Va à leur rencontre et fais-les tomber à genoux. Délivre-moi des méchants par {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} épée,
fr.R: Lève-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Dresse-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} contre eux et renverse-les ! Sers-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} épée pour me sauver des méchants.

sw.L: Inuka, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ukabiliane na uso wake; umwangushe chini; uiokoe nafsi yangu na mwovu [kwa] upanga {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}},
sw.B: Simama, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Ukutane nao uso kwa uso na uwapigishe magoti. Uniokoe na waovu kwa upanga {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}},
sw.R: Amka, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Simama dhidi yao na uwaangushe! Utumie upanga {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kuniokoa na watu waovu.

es.L: Levántate, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, sal al encuentro de su rostro; hazlo doblegarse; libra mi alma del malvado [con] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} espada,
es.B: ¡Álzate, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! Hazles frente y ponlos de rodillas. Rescátame de los malvados con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} espada,
es.R: ¡Levántate, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! ¡Ponte contra ellos y derríbalos! Usa {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} espada para salvarme de los malvados.

decisions.choice: Arise, LORD
decisions.reason: As in 3:8 (Numbers 10:35).

decisions.choice: confront his face: meet him head on
decisions.reason: The LORD is asked to step in front of the attacker, as the lion of verse 12 crouches to spring.

decisions.choice: your sword: God's sword, or the wicked as God's sword
alternatives: from the wicked, who are your sword
decisions.reason: "Your sword" most likely tells how God rescues. It could also call the wicked God's sword, the tool he uses to discipline (Isaiah 10:5).

decisions.choice: them (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew describes one figure ("he", "his") who stands for everyone who acts this way. Balanced and Readable make the portrait plural, as Psalm 10 does with "the wicked", which includes men and women alike; Literal keeps the Hebrew singular.

source.text: מִֽמְתִ֥ים יָדְךָ֨׀יְהוָ֡ה מִֽמְתִ֬ים מֵחֶ֗לֶד חֶלְקָ֥ם בַּֽחַיִּים֮ וּֽצְפוּנְךָ֮ תְּמַלֵּ֪א בִ֫טְנָ֥ם יִשְׂבְּע֥וּ בָנִ֑ים וְהִנִּ֥יחוּ יִ֝תְרָ֗ם לְעוֹלְלֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: from men, [by] your hand, YHWH, from men of [the] world, their portion [is] in the life, and [with] your treasured [things] you fill their belly; they are satisfied [with] sons and they leave their abundance to their children.

en.L: from men [by] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, from men of the world, whose portion [is] in [this] life, and whose belly {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} fill with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} treasure; they are satisfied with sons, and they leave what is left over to their little ones.
en.B: from such people, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, by {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand, from people of this world whose share is in this life alone. You fill their stomachs with what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have stored up; their children have plenty, and they leave what is left to their little ones.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, use {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} power to save me from people like this. All they care about is this life. You give them plenty to eat. They have many children and leave their riches to them.

fr.L: des mortels [par] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, des mortels de ce monde, dont la part [est] dans [cette] vie, et dont {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} remplis le ventre de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} réserves ; ils sont rassasiés de fils, et ils laissent leur surplus à leurs petits.
fr.B: de ces gens-là, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, par {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main, des gens de ce monde, qui n’ont leur part que dans cette vie. Tu leur remplis le ventre de ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as mis en réserve ; leurs enfants ont tout en abondance, et ils laissent le reste à leurs petits.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, sers-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} puissance pour me sauver de ces gens-là. Ils ne s’intéressent qu’à cette vie. Tu leur donnes beaucoup à manger. Ils ont beaucoup d’enfants et leur laissent leurs richesses.

sw.L: kutoka kwa watu [kwa] mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kutoka kwa watu wa dunia, ambao fungu lao [liko] katika maisha [haya], na ambao tumbo lao unalijaza kwa hazina {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; wanashiba wana, nao huwaachia wadogo wao kilichosalia.
sw.B: kutoka kwa watu kama hao, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, kutoka kwa watu wa dunia hii ambao fungu lao ni katika maisha haya tu. Unayajaza matumbo yao kwa yale uliyoyaweka akiba; watoto wao wana vingi, nao huwaachia wadogo wao kilichobaki.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, utumie nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} kuniokoa na watu kama hawa. Wanachojali tu ni maisha haya. Unawapa chakula kingi. Wana watoto wengi na kuwaachia mali zao.

es.L: de los hombres, [con] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, de los hombres del mundo, cuya porción [está] en [esta] vida, y cuyo vientre {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} llenas con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} tesoro; se sacian de hijos, y dejan lo que les sobra a sus pequeños.
es.B: de esa gente, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano, de la gente de este mundo cuya parte está solo en esta vida. Tú llenas su estómago con lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has guardado; sus hijos tienen de sobra, y dejan lo que queda a sus pequeños.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, usa {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} poder para salvarme de gente así. Lo único que les importa es esta vida. Tú les das mucho de comer. Tienen muchos hijos y les dejan sus riquezas.

decisions.choice: you fill their belly: blessing or judgment
alternatives: you fill their belly with punishment you have stored up for them
decisions.reason: The verse is very hard. "What you have stored up" may be good things God gives even to the worldly, or the punishment he holds back for them (Job 21:19). The words are kept as open as the Hebrew leaves them.

decisions.choice: your treasured things: the word as read, not as written
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text writes the word in one form and its notes say to read it in a closely related form; the meaning is the same. The words follow the form to be read.

decisions.choice: men of the world, whose portion is in this life: people who live for now
decisions.reason: Their whole share is in this passing life, unlike the psalmist, whose share is the LORD (16:5).

decisions.choice: men: mortals
decisions.reason: The word (metim) means men, people; it is not the usual word for man.

decisions.choice: use your power
decisions.reason: As in verse 7, the hand stands for power.

source.text: אֲנִ֗י בְּ֭צֶדֶק אֶחֱזֶ֣ה פָנֶ֑יךָ אֶשְׂבְּעָ֥ה בְ֝הָקִ֗יץ תְּמוּנָתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: I, in righteousness I will see your face; I will be satisfied when [I] awake [with] your form.

en.L: As for me, in righteousness I will see {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face; I will be satisfied, when [I] awake, [with] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} form.
en.B: But I, in the right, will look on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face; when I wake up, the sight of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will be all I want.
en.R: But I live in the right way, so I will see {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face. When I wake up, I will see {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and that will be enough for me.

fr.L: Quant à moi, dans la justice je verrai {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face ; je serai rassasié, quand [je] m’éveillerai, [de] {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} image.
fr.B: Mais moi, étant dans mon droit, je contemplerai {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face ; à mon réveil, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} voir sera tout ce que je désire.
fr.R: Mais moi, je vis comme il faut, alors je verrai {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} visage. Quand je me réveillerai, je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} verrai, et cela me suffira.

sw.L: Mimi, katika haki nitauona uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}; nitashiba, nitakapoamka, [kwa] sura {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Lakini mimi, nikiwa katika haki, nitautazama uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}; nitakapoamka, kukuona {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} kutakuwa ndicho ninachotamani tu.
sw.R: Lakini mimi ninaishi kwa njia iliyo sahihi, kwa hiyo nitauona uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}. Nitakapoamka, nitakuona {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, na hilo litanitosha.

es.L: Yo, en justicia contemplaré {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro; quedaré saciado, al despertar, [con] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} figura.
es.B: Pero yo, en lo justo, miraré {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro; cuando despierte, verte será todo lo que desee.
es.R: Pero yo vivo de la manera correcta, así que veré {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro. Cuando despierte, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} veré, y eso me bastará.

decisions.choice: I: set against the men of the world
decisions.reason: They are satisfied with children and wealth (verse 14); the psalmist will be satisfied with God himself. The same verb ("satisfied") is used in both verses.

decisions.choice: your form: God's likeness as he shows himself
decisions.reason: The word (temunah) is the form in which God showed himself to Moses (Numbers 12:8).

decisions.choice: when I awake: after the night, or after death
alternatives: when I wake from the sleep of death
decisions.reason: "Awake" may mean the morning after a night of danger (3:6), or, as many have read it, waking from death (Isaiah 26:19; Daniel 12:2).

decisions.choice: see your face: be welcome in God's presence
decisions.reason: As in 11:7.
